run_local_launcher: run a list of shell commands serially on the local machine using local_launcher
run_dummy_launcher: print each command without executing it using dummy_launcher for testing purposes
run_multi_gpu_launcher: launch commands in parallel across all available GPUs using multi_gpu_launcher
review_REGISTRY: review the REGISTRY dictionary that maps launcher names to their corresponding launcher functions
test_local_launcher: test the local_launcher function by passing a list of shell commands to execute
